an10.91:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an10.91:1.2: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:-- 2.
an10.91:2.1: Dasa yime gahapati kāmabhogī santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an10.91:2.3: Idha gahapati ekacco kāmabhogī adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena,
an10.91:2.4: adhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena na attānaṃ sukheti pīneti, na saṃvibhajati na puññāni karoti. 4.

an10.91:11.1: Idha pana gahapati ekacco kāmabhogī dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasena,
an10.91:11.2: dhammena bhoge pariyesitvā asāhasena attānaṃ sukheti pīneti, saṃvibhajati puññāni karoti,
an10.91:11.3: te ca bhoge agadhito amucchito anajjhāpanno ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati. 13.
an10.91:12.1: Tatra gahapati yvāyaṃ kāmabhogī adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena, adhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena na attānaṃ sukheti pīneti. na saṃvibhajati na puññāni karoti: ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī tīhi ṭhānehi gārayho.
an10.91:12.2: Adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasenā ti iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena gārayho,
an10.91:12.3: na attānam sukheti pīnetī ti iminā dutiyena ṭhānena gārayho,
an10.91:12.4: na saṃvibhajati na puññāni karotī ti iminā tatiyena ṭhānena gārayho.
an10.91:12.5: Ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī imehi tīhi ṭhānehi gārayho. 14.
an10.91:13.1: Tatra gahapati yvāyaṃ kāmabhogī adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasena, adhammena bhoge pariyesitvā sāhasena attānaṃ sukheti pīneti, na saṃvibhajati na puññāni karoti: ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī dvīhi ṭhānehi gārayho, ekena ṭhānena pāsaṃso.
an10.91:13.2: Adhammena bhoge pariyesati sāhasenā ti iminā paṭhamena ṭhānena gārayho,
an10.91:13.3: attānaṃ sukheti pīnetī ti iminā ekena ṭhānena pāsaṃso,
an10.91:13.4: na saṃvibhajati na puññāni karotī ti iminā dutiyena ṭhānena gārayho.
an10.91:13.5: Ayaṃ gahapati kāmabhogī imehi dvīhi ṭhānehi gārayho, iminā ekena ṭhānena pāsaṃso. 15.

an10.91:22.1: Ime kho gahapati dasa kāmabhogī santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. 23.
an10.91:22.2: Imesaṃ kho gahapati dasannaṃ kāmabhogīnaṃ yvāyaṃ kāmabhogī dhammena bhoge pariyesati asāhasena, dhammena bhoge pariyesitvā asāhasena attānaṃ sukheti pīneti, saṃvibhajati puññāni karoti, te ca bhoge agadhito amucchito anajjhāpanno ādīnavadassāvī nissaraṇapañño paribhuñjati: ayaṃ imesaṃ dasannaṃ kāmabhogīnaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca pāmokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca.
